title: Dynamic Stretching Focused On Shooting Technique

source.sectionHeading: SPECIAL DYNAMIC STRETCHING TO PREPARE FOR SHOOTING

setup: All players lined up side by side.
instructions: Walking, raise one arm horizontally, touch the opposite toes to your fingertips at each step. 30 yards.
Walking, raise your knee and touch it to the opposite armpit, with the opposite arm down in front of the knee. 30 yards.
Skipping - high knees, big arm swings. 30 yards, two laps. Make sure they are raising opposite knees and arms.

High Kick - jogging pace, swing and kick an imaginary ball with as much power as possible. Your leg swing should be diagonal, bringing your knee under the opposite armpit. Your leg swing should have as much power as possible, and swing as high as possible, lifting you off the ground. The other exercises build up to this. 30 yards, 3 laps.
coachingPoints: Most players can't shoot well not because they lack muscle strength, but because they lack the coordination needed to shoot efficiently.

These dynamic stretching exercises, when done every practice and every game as part of your warmup, will produce excellent coordination over the whole season, and will dramatically improve their shooting.

derived.formation: Players side by side, working over 30 yards
